description: Create a property video from a list of images. Blocks server-side until the video is rendered (up to ~10 min) and returns the finished video URL inline.

images.description: Ordered list of images that make up the video.

effect.description: Animation for this image. Defaults to "zoom-in" (AI, 5 credits). "transition" morphs between two photos; "sky-transition" changes only the sky and light between two versions of the same photo (day to night, day to sunset); both need secondImageUrl and cost 5 credits. "lite-zoom-in" / "lite-zoom-out" are a free, subtler 3D push (no AI video, 0 credits). "static" is a still frame, also free.

imageUrl.description: Source image: a public https:// URL, a data: URI, or an absolute path to a local image file on this computer (the file is read and inlined automatically). If the photo is on the user's device and can't be read from here (e.g. it's on their phone), get a link from pedra_create_upload_link.

track.description: Genre key from pedra_music_library (e.g. acoustic, chill, cinematic, electronic, upbeat).

audioId.description: Id of a voiceover from pedra_generate_voice. Drives the narration and its synced subtitles.

showSubtitles.description: Burn in word-synced subtitles. Defaults to true.

name: pedra_create_video
title: Create property video
